note: Keyless fixtures for the roadmap UI. IDs are stable across files. Not real data.

fixtures.invitation-offered: Server offered the two-choice invitation after a Markdown source became ready and the chat was idle.
fixtures.invitation-suppressed: Auto-suggest is off: nothing is offered; an explicit request still creates a roadmap.
fixtures.invitation-dismiss: Dismissing one invitation. It does not disable future invitations.
fixtures.create-request: Create a roadmap from an invitation. instruction is the learner words, unchanged.
fixtures.create-request-passage: Create from a selected passage: R3 minted the sref_ id when the learner selected it. The server re-reads it under the session and finds the quote in the source once.
fixtures.create-response-draft: Planning runs in the background; poll status. Nothing is generated and nothing is charged to the learner.
fixtures.status-questioning: Generic context: one focused question before any plan.
fixtures.status-limitation: Source above the supported bound: say so, offer a supported scope. Never a silent prefix.
fixtures.status-proposed-plan: Editable proposed roadmap awaiting plan acceptance. proposal is null: no step is offered yet.
fixtures.revise-request: Plan revision through the ToC conversation. A material change returns a revised plan for acceptance.
fixtures.accept-plan-request: Accept plan v2. Authorizes nothing to be generated and charges nothing.
fixtures.status-active-proposal-pending: Polling before acceptance: proposal metadata only. No generated text, no answer key, no R2 location, no result id.
fixtures.accept-proposal-request: Tab or the Accept button. proposalVersion guards a stale pill. No price is sent or shown.
fixtures.accept-proposal-response-generating: Acceptance consumed once; card ids minted by the server before generation; the client reserves these slots.
fixtures.accept-proposal-replay: The same actionKey again (retry, second tab): the recorded outcome, same status and body, no second purchase.
fixtures.error-stale-409: A different device accepted first. The body carries the current state.
fixtures.error-insufficient-allowance: Aggregate allowance check failed: the proposal stays pending, nothing consumed, nothing charged. Body keys follow the existing refusal body (learn-spend-ledger.js refusalBody).
fixtures.result-deliver-response: Predicate passed: authorized blocks to insert idempotently. Then the client saves the board and posts the ack.
fixtures.result-ack-request: Placement acknowledgement after the board save succeeded. A lost ack is a delivery reconciliation case, not a new purchase.
fixtures.status-delivered-next-ready: Step 1 delivered. The next proposal exists but may be offscreen: the Next step ready indicator only navigates.
fixtures.status-cancelled-paused: Cancel marks the proposal cancelled and pauses automatic progression. Manual Propose next step stays available.
fixtures.status-failed-card: Card failed after its one automatic retry; learner charges refunded; the step is closed (skipped). No Retry, Replace or Omit (owner 2026-11-06).
fixtures.status-held-for-checking: Generated but checks unavailable: withheld. No text is surfaced until the bounded check finishes; terminal inability refunds the card.
fixtures.status-completed: Stopping point reached. Continuing needs a new explicit request or accepted revision.
fixtures.end-request: End roadmap keeps delivered cards and history.
fixtures.flag-off: ROADMAP_ENABLED unset or not "true": every roadmap route answers 404 as if absent; UI hidden.
fixtures.error-forbidden-read: Result route for a result the actor is not entitled to read: 404, indistinguishable from a missing id.
